description: This is the E.F. Johnson implementation of aRandom Number Generator algorithm for Windows 2000, Windows XP, and PocketPC 2003. This Random Number Generator is based on Appendix 3, Section 3.1of the FIPS 186-2 standard. It can be used when random number generation isrequired for DSA usage or for more general random number generation cases.This algorithm is part of the Communication Cryptographic Librarymodule which is used in the E.F. Johnson PCKeyloader - Key EncryptionProgrammer application.
